mapper.update: UPDATE wb_run SET status = #{status}, stop_reason = #{stopReason}, iter_count = #{iterCount}, input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, ended_at = now(), duration_ms = #{durationMs} WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYYMMDD') AS date, count(*) AS value FROM wb_run WHERE created_at >= now() - (#{days} || ' days')::interval GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYYMMDD') AS date, coalesce(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) AS value FROM wb_run WHERE created_at >= now() - (#{days} || ' days')::interval GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
